mechanism_claims.claim_text: Five alligator-derived candidate peptides showed direct antibacterial activity in bacterial survival assays; this supports antimicrobial effect, not a specific molecular target mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The hydrogel particle workflow captures low-molecular-weight cationic peptides through affinity/size-exclusion properties and is a discovery/enrichment context rather than a peptide antimicrobial mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This explains how candidate peptides were harvested, not how active peptides kill bacteria.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CAMP/AntiBP2/APD2 predictions are computational triage evidence and cannot be promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism evidence.
